title: Git + PR events
detail: Repository hooks, commit SHAs, Git tags, pull requests. A port allows other Git hosts later.
invariant: Never assume a branch or tag is immutable; resolve and pin a commit.

title: Portal clients
detail: Browser UI and existing Git workflows. No development agent is dispatched by the platform.
invariant: Every action is authorized by organization and team membership.

title: Products & environments
detail: Assets to assess. Product adapter only exposes typed subjects and authorized input.
invariant: Observations must identify environment and target revision/digest.

title: HTTP API + Auth
detail: OpenAPI endpoints for products, teams, packs, assessments, findings and UI. OIDC auth and RBAC.
invariant: Backend processes must be stateless and horizontally replaceable.

title: Event inbox / queue
detail: Deduplicates webhooks and queues independent assessment jobs with leases and retries.
invariant: Idempotency key: provider event + repository + head SHA + pack revision.

title: Product registry
detail: Products and owner teams plus discovered typed subjects and scope completeness.
invariant: Missing discovery never silently means NOT_APPLICABLE or PASS.

title: Git Pack resolver
detail: Loads manifests from Git, validates schema, stores provenance and pinned immutable revision.
invariant: Keep governance packs distinct from provider packs; no PDF processing in core.

title: Assessment engine
detail: Matches controls to subjects, resolves evidence requirements and evaluates deterministic rules.
invariant: Explicit PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN, NOT_APPLICABLE; exact version binding.

title: Provider orchestration
detail: Schedules approved isolated collector runtimes; understands typed requests, JSON schemas, timeouts and provenance only.
invariant: Never compile Terraform into core; actual collectors are owned by provider packs.

title: PostgreSQL
detail: Organizations, resources, principals, manifests, assessments, results, events, audit and jobs.
invariant: Schema migrations and indexes are portable across managed and self-hosted PostgreSQL.

title: Object store
detail: Larger signed evidence artefacts and attachments; local compatible service or managed object store.
invariant: Never place credentials or raw secrets in general-purpose evidence.

title: Isolated collector
detail: Approved OCI image runs external evidence logic. One pack might use Terraform data sources internally, another cloud APIs or a parser.
invariant: Pinned image, narrow permissions, egress policy, CPU/memory/time limits, validated output.

title: PR check + short comment
detail: One bot comment updated per PR; a separate commit-bound required status check. No agent dispatch.
invariant: A stale SHA must never overwrite the status/comment for the newest head SHA.

title: Baseline & change impact
detail: Independent assessments for deployments and newly activated governance revisions, plus lifecycle findings.
invariant: Never treat proposed PR-state evidence as proof of production-state compliance.
